notes.title: Notice of Future Responses
notes.content:
This is TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC development team.

We will be taking your reviews, evaluations, and comments seriously and will consider and implement the following measures.

1. The following changes and additions will be made as soon as possible.

　(1) Automation of text playback and change of text display speed
　(2) Fast-forwarding of the text function
　(3) Enabling options to be called up during ADV.
　(4) When a report is written, support to be able to return to the previous survey screen.
　(5) Function to auto-save at the timing when saving is possible.

2. The following items to be addressed/reviewed sequentially

　(1) Correction and consideration of items that are difficult to see in the UI/UX
　(2) Reduce the number of operation request buttons for switching modes and switching physical evidence in video analysis.
　(3) Expand the range of possible double-speed video playback to match the machine specifications of the platform.
　(4) Consideration of key configuration adjustment function for each operation screen.

Thank you very much for your valuable review, evaluation and feedback.
We will keep you posted as soon as we have a definite update schedule.

Thank you for your continued support of TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC.

notes.title: Final Introduction of Features in TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC!
notes.content:
Hello detectives,

As a new member of the Paranormal Detective Agency it will be essential to understand the tools you have here at HQ, so we’ve prepared a little refresher for you. Pay close attention as there’s quite a bit to cover… but once we’re done you’ll be able to handle even the most confounding of paranormal cases.

[h2]Analysis Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/38b66b04779135b7960e035c8e478c0464f42a28.gif[/img]
You can read through evidence and other materials related to your case. When you enter Analysis Mode, an eye-shaped cursor will appear. You can use this to find words that may be related to the case. Tomona will talk to you when analyzing key words highlighted in red, providing you valuable information to progress your investigation.

[h2]Brightness Adjustment Tool[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/afc51c73c909773917a8e733efdb0e96b84a3961.gif[/img]
Brightness of images and photos being analyzed can be adjusted for closer inspection of details. This may allow you to see pieces of evidence that were previously indiscernible.

[h2]Audio Tool/Audio Analysis[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/e9e4e8a5359ad36a72c7523774dfe43e2b6df0e8.gif[/img]
You can use specialized equipment to analyze audio files saved on the PC and cassette tapes etc. that contain recorded audio. Detected sound and voices are divided into blocks, and individual frames are displayed as the audio plays. You can clip out blocks of audio waveforms that the AI detects and isolate it for further inspection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/efc7be731be49cf91dc1596406ec476bfd3c766b.gif[/img]

In audio analysis, you can compare audio clips and sound waves that the AI detects.
When a target has been found on both displays, start the analysis function and determine how close of a match the two audios are.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/258444cccf1fb92d0447096fc335bffbd3096db5.gif[/img]

[h2]Report[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/2ef732d848b606e0fbe096296e1b63782d33fc1b.gif[/img]
Prepare a report summarizing your investigation of the case. Select screenshots, documents, or photos that support your answers and Tomona will give you an assessment of how accurate your answer and evidence are. When you have completed all the answers, you can submit your report.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/f7c9045edb2f258acbc0a2610b34f09e581f8322.jpg[/img]

[h2]Door [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/f01655fb86ecfa5f7cd1760b7484ac03f0b57b91.gif[/img]
You can use the door to go outside during investigations. The map will be displayed when you select the door, and you can choose a destination. The available destinations change with each case and update as your investigation progresses. There are over 11 locations that will appear in total, be sure to take a break and check the map now and then. Your interactions with characters may provide useful leads in your case.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/4e8ca081dd979315036e4c053d83ac61cadbcdd3.jpg[/img]

[h2]BGM[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/a11775dbcf0a013bc73a230ac64cc7f018e110e9.gif[/img]
Listen to different background music tracks. Remember that it’s just as important to take time for yourself between all the investigations. Treat your ears to something soothing to help clear your mind… but don’t slack off too much!

We hope you’ll make the best use of all the tools at your disposal to progress in your cases. For now, we hope you’re looking forward to the official English release of TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC! Full Japanese release will be May 30th, 2024… but expect some news on the official English release soon! This should give you plenty of time to brush up on everything you’ve learned so far, rookie.
 
Until the next one.

The TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC Team

notes.title: Part 2 of the Mind-Bending Mysteries in TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC!
notes.content:
Hello, detectives!
In anticipation of the upcoming release of Tokyo Psychodemic, we’d like to introduce you to some of the mysterious and mind-bending cases you can expect. As a rookie member of the Paranormal Detective Agency, you’ll be opening up cases that have been left unsolved. Is murder afoot in Tokyo? Or could it be a case of paranormal activity…? It’s up to you and your team to uncover the truth.

[u][h2]CASE 3: Akasaka Spirited Away[/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/e6ca39a836f70bd9dfa31af0ebc263bc96085a6b.jpg[/img]
The next mysterious case is a case of being “spirited away” in which three important politicians, including the deputy prime minister and his secretary, disappear from an elevator of a 12-story hotel. The protagonist and his partner, Tomona Akiba, see a potential connection to the Yamanoi cult and set out to investigate the case.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/157ffaa0df83898995928f55bf5532c3f734902e.jpg[/img]
This time around the stakes are high, as after 48 hours the missing person’s probability of survival decreases… What is the cause of the disappearance of a big-name politician? Is it really a case of being spirited away? Or is criminal activity at play?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/78fdc807844fc9d5f39f4005f135e6aeb9a4e636.png[/img]
To be spirited away means to suddenly disappear without a trace. It is a phenomenon that has been occurring in many parts of the world since ancient times. When a ship returns from a disaster and only a person is missing, or when a person suddenly disappears without a single witness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/ce79cf0b41ba3c3de2a35c1b9c0c1509acae00c8.gif[/img]
And to get to the bottom of this case you’ll have to investigate the elevators of every floor… of a 12 story building!? It may sound daunting, but with guidance from Tomona you'll pick up on clues and leads soon enough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/8fa7cc4e6481842b001d08af9646e7f0458dedca.gif[/img]
Will the deputy prime minister be found safe and sound? Are there supernatural forces at work behind the incident? Everything depends on the player's deductions.

This case unlocks a new tool for deeper forensics: the “Audio Analysis” tool. This allows the player to isolate specific sound frequencies and hear sounds that were not heard before. Hear and extract the parts of the sound waveform that are of interest to you and have your fellow investigators examine them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/924ee2ea56be7ce7f1c75edb68dbf27da43a2628.gif[/img]

[h2][u]CASE 4: ? ? ? [/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/6388e546614fd1059b5c8cfab1c4fffb939dc754.jpg[/img]
Following the sudden explosion of a plane outbound from Tokyo, the detective agency receives a mysterious usb with audio recording from within the cockpit of the plane. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/b53ecf1a8894300fa7e7c2b2fdc454e0460669bf.jpg[/img]
The audio seems to point to this being a bombing, with an audio record of what seem to be Russian terrorists aboard the plane. Although the usb audio is in Russian, it’s no problem since the audio analysis tool is equipped with AI recognition of a multitude of languages. 

That’s right, this case will fully utilize the newest feature added to your arsenal - the audio analysis tool
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/258444cccf1fb92d0447096fc335bffbd3096db5.gif[/img]
The usb not only has the main audio that has been officially assessed by investigators… but additional audio, too from a passenger on board.
Consult the Dark Web to receive an audio analysis and find leads in your case.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/38a28db9fc93e7e088b1a9db2a9b39ad758a91bb.gif[/img]
Your investigation will take some turns, and even take you outside of the office…
Take pictures, and gather evidence to analyze back at the headquarters.

In addition to the usual flow of the case, there will be several instances to choose from several options and see different outcomes for each choice. Don’t feel pressure as each option will simply provide additional information rather than change the outcome of the case itself.

This particular case is slightly longer than the others, and will take many sudden unexpected turns throughout as each clue leads to revealing an even deeper layer to the mystery, you’re sure to fall deep into this mystery as the direction is completely unexpected!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/f30e16d0077b983f5269a25ce84ef8724ab76829.png[/img]
Which case are you most excited to solve? Stay tuned for details of the next two cases! 

Be sure to follow TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC socials for even more details on production.
Until the next one.

The TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC Team

notes.title: Introducing the Variety of Features in TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC!
notes.content:
Hello Detectives,

We know you’re just getting the hang of things as a new member of the Paranormal Detective Agency, so we’ve prepared a little refresher on all the tools you have available to you. Make sure to pay close attention and take notes if you need to, you’ll be using these features often while solving mysterious cases.

[h2]Image/Video Analysis:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/dd564877859f4b1a48bc5cc9e857eced0dde425b.gif[/img]

There are two displays, D1 (left) and D2 (right), so you can view a different video or image on each one. If you want to get a closer look at a piece of media, you can switch one display to full screen mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/0f6b1ac3cbae92e1aca220ea459ceb4d5a67099a.gif[/img]

You can pause, play, rewind, and fast-forward any video footage you have.
The specialized equipment can even scan the video automatically and detect faces via AI.

[h2]The Evidence Board:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/ad6a22abd3509161ce289d079b51dba23acdbda1.gif[/img]

Evidence and other information for cases is displayed on the evidence board. Any connections found will be shown with a thread. 

There may be blank photos with a "?"written on it. You can pin any evidence you'd like here. Evidence you post may progress your investigation, or lead you further from the truth.

[h2]Consult the Dark Web:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/0e67a90c4c9b0fc037351ebc99599b9bf47b2bdb.gif[/img]

The dark web is like a secret hideout on the internet, only accessible to you and the colleagues who are helping you with the investigation. When there's a thread on the dark web, you can obtain info from your colleagues or upload data that can be discussed with them.

[h2]Save your Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/3f7b14dbf3f127e9ee5a404ae8bc2124473e72ff.gif[/img]

Save your investigation progress by resting on the sofa. You can create multiple save files and choose which slot to save them in.

[h2]Feed the Cat:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021040/a2779713f38558afe01b94725c5fde5e57270097.gif[/img]

Let’s not forget the most essential feature to your investigation… giving Cat a treat now and then. Just a joke, but since he’s always hanging around, why not give him some affection now and then?

We hope you’ll make the best use of all the tools at your disposal to make progress on your cases. We’ll be briefing you for a second round of system introduction soon, so be ready to learn even more about the features available to you.

Until the next one.

- The TOKYO PSYCHODEMIC Team
